result:
The candidate meets the code side of every Change item, but I found one blocking gap. Change 2 says the new GBP Settings must be documented in both ACCESS.md and IMPORT.md, and IMPORT.md was not updated. Both test suites pass, and the fake load is clean on run 1 and makes no writes on run 2.

```
VERDICT: FINDINGS
CANDIDATE: 68c32e2f59b45b1a1058873e46f55e3b3e6778b0
FINDING import-md-settings-undocumented blocking: Change 2 says "ACCESS.md and IMPORT.md document them" (the Settings currencyList/defaultCurrency/baseCurrency GBP and phoneNumberInternational false, now applied by provision_access.py from config/settings.json). Only ACCESS.md was updated. | evidence: `git diff dfe1d55f..68c32e2f -- docs/IMPORT.md | grep -c '^+.*\(currency\|Currency\|settings.json\)'` → 0; `grep -n 'GBP\|currencyList\|settings.json\|baseCurrency\|defaultCurrency' docs/IMPORT.md` → only the old line 118 (`amountCurrency: GBP`). docs/IMPORT.md:24 still lists the prerequisites without the currency Settings, and docs/IMPORT.md:26 still says only "CRM-007 sets it on beta" for phoneNumberInternational. | expected: the IMPORT.md prerequisites state that the target must have currencyList ["GBP"] and default/base currency GBP (otherwise `400 amount validCurrency`), and that provision_access.py sets these from config/settings.json.
FINDING owner-not-required-untested advisory: no test checks that Contact and Opportunity rows with an unresolved owner are still created with `owner_unresolved` (Change 3, second sentence). The code is right (require_owner is only called from task() for Task/Call and from event()), but the tests cannot catch a regression. | evidence: in a scratch copy I added `self.require_owner(attrs, exc)` to Mapper.contact, then to Mapper.opportunity; the load suite still passed both times (`Ran 150 … OK`). The same mutation in Mapper.account is caught (4 failures). Adding "Email" to OWNER_REQUIRED (mapping.py) also survives (`OK`). | expected: a load test where a Contact, an Opportunity and a Task-Email routed to an existing Email have an unresolved owner, asserting the record is written and gets owner_unresolved, not owner_required_unresolved.
FINDING null-required-name advisory: _limit_lengths (engine.py) sends any over-length attribute as null, including Account `name` (249) and ServiceType `name` (150). Those names are required, so the server would refuse such a record (write_rejected) instead of reporting it cleanly. This follows the WO exactly, and the PL counted no real values over these limits, so it is not blocking. | evidence: mapping.json maxLength lists Account.name 249 and ServiceType.name 150; the `elif` branch of _limit_lengths sets out[a]=None with no exception for required attributes. | expected: (PL decision) either keep this as is, or refuse records whose required attribute is too long.
EVIDENCE:
- `git -C /srv/CRM/worktrees/CRM-008 rev-parse HEAD` → 68c32e2f59b45b1a1058873e46f55e3b3e6778b0; status clean at the start and at the end. Ignored scripts/__pycache__ and tests/unit/__pycache__ were already there before my first command.
- Scope: `git diff --stat/--summary dfe1d55f..68c32e2f` touches 22 files, all inside the allowlist. The 6 Change 9 files are mode 100644→100755 only. Contact.json adds `title.maxLength: 255` only.
- Suites (PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, -B): `tests/unit` → Ran 333, OK (1 skipped: php lint, no php). `python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests/load -t .` → Ran 150, OK.
- Reference extractor: copied CRM-006R/ref into scratch with CONTRACT_VERSION 4. `crm-migrate selftest --out` (full) → status=RECONCILED checks=28 failed=0. Sealed it as `full-selftest` (dirs 0700, files 0400).
- Pipeline (aud/bin/run.py; FakeEspo starts at currencyList ["USD"], users from `crm-load users`): provision_settings run 1 → updated (only baseCurrency, currencyList, defaultCurrency sent); run 2 → unchanged. Load run-1 → rc 0, 284 writes, every target failed=0, 0 write_rejected. Re-run → rc 0, 0 writes. exceptions byReason includes owner_required_unresolved 1, task_email_imported_as_task 6, value_too_long 102 (attributes addressPostalCode and shippingAddressPostalCode only), email_address_invalid 35, synthetic_enum_mapped 119. Meeting created 32, failed 0.
- Sequential run (aud/bin/seq.py): run-1 → 284 writes, 0 failed; then run-2 snapshot → 1 write, 0 failed; then run-2 again → 0 writes.
- Content check: `grep -c SENTINEL` → 0 in both logs, exceptions.jsonl, load-report.json and progress.jsonl. Exception lines have only object/sfId/reason (+attributes). Log events are gate/index/object/settings/run/load_result/phone_refusals.
- Mutations (aud/bin/mut.py on a `git archive` copy, never the worktree): all caught. Unit suite: delete controller (2 failures), skip ensure_settings (2), Settings send-all (7), role_desired=dict(role) (7), "info" back in ROLE_ATTRIBUTES (2), load.sh 0644 (1). Load suite: owner refusal off (2), task-email routing off (3), maxLength off (2), phone >36 branch off (1), truncate instead of null (1), loose email regex (3), To/Cc not dropped (2), from not refusing (2), Event.Type synthetic off (1). Surviving mutations are listed in the advisory above.
- Settings idempotence and role info: test_provision covers a second run against a fake that drops unknown Role attributes → 0 writes, role unchanged 4, settings unchanged 1. Mutation-confirmed.
- No delete path added (no DELETE in the diff). No placeholder owner: require_owner only removes owner_unresolved and adds the refusal code.
- gitleaks: `--no-git` on the candidate tree → no leaks; `--log-opts dfe1d55f..68c32e2f` → 1 commit, no leaks. The diff has no host addresses (only fake.example.test and the test literal a@[127.0.0.1]).
- Note: the scratch root already contained files I did not create (mut.py, mut2.py, pipeline.py, p/, ref/, st/). mut.py edits the worktree in place. I did not run them; all my work is under scratch/aud/.
```
